title: Meta Ads at $0.003 Per Engagement and $0.31 Per Follower
subtitle: Cross-platform paid social strategy costs fractions of a penny per engagement and 3 followers per $0.93 spent
seo_title: Social Advertising Strategy $0.003 Cost Per Engagement
seo_description: Strategic social media ad campaigns across Meta platforms achieving $0.003 per engagement and $0.31 per follower through targeted content optimization.
thumb_alt: Social advertising analytics dashboard showing $0.003 cost per engagement, Instagram shop performance with 9,200+ views, and fashion lookbook creative assets
challenge: The brands have only been active for a handful of weeks meaning our core audience is still in development. A successful strategy will need to reach target users without leaning too heavily on any expectation of content being pushed further out by current audience. This can sometimes increase cost and will ultimately come down to effective targeting.
approach: Implemented a data-driven advertising strategy across Meta platforms, combining innovative audience targeting with carefully crafted, effective A/B testing. Each campaign used an iterative creative optimization, testing visual formats, copy variations, and audience segments to identify the highest-performing combinations. The lookbook assets were designed specifically for hip social users with careful focus on ensuring a visual hook stops scrolling to drive engagement.
result: Achieved $0.003 cost per engagement and $0.31 cost per follower. Instagram shop campaigns generated 9,200+ views per cycle. The strategy provided cost efficiency from carefully crafted creative testing combined with precise audience targeting, avoiding any need to increase budgets.
